truth.description: resolveExportsOrImports now matches package exports only against options.conditions and adds development or production only for a development|production entry, but createCSSResolvers in css.ts still builds its css, sass and less resolvers with conditions such as ['style'] that omit that entry, so a CSS @import of a package whose style export is split into development and production files fails to resolve.

distractions.why: The conditions list stays in the cache key and now carries everything overrideConditions and webCompatible used to vary, so resolutions with different conditions still never share a cached entry.
